pages.ja:
……半分以上の確率で、遠坂の目的は俺だろう。
ただ、気になるのはあいつの行動だ。
遠坂の性格からいって、俺に用があるなら躊躇う事なく外に連れ出すだろうに、どうしてまた、あんなフツーの女生徒みたいなコトをしてるんだろう？

pages.en:
…There is a better than even chance that I am the reason Tohsaka is here.

What bothers me is the way she is going about it.

Knowing Tohsaka, if she had business with me, she would march in and drag me outside without a moment's hesitation. Why is she acting like such an ordinary schoolgirl all of a sudden?
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Tohsaka must want to talk to me.
But I’m curious why she’s acting that way.
Considering Tohsaka, she would drag me out if she has business with me. So why is she acting like an ordinary schoolgirl?

pages.ja:
「……放っておきたいけど、そうはいかないよな……なにより後が怖い」
弁当箱を片手に席を立つ。
後で後藤くんを筆頭にした男どもの詰問を覚悟して廊下に向かった。
pages.jaRuby:
「……放っておきたいけど、そうはいかないよな……なにより後が怖い」

pages.en:
“…I'd rather leave her to it, but I can't exactly do that. The consequences would be terrifying.”

I rise from my desk with my lunchbox in hand.

Resigning myself to the interrogation Gotou and the other boys will inflict upon me later, I head into the corridor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I want to ignore her, but I guess I can’t… More than anything, I’m scared of what she’ll do to me if I do ignore her.”
I get up with my lunchbox.
I prepare myself for the questioning I’ll get from Gotou-kun and the other guys after I get back.

pages.ja:
「遠坂。なにしてんだよ、こんなところで」
「なっ、なにって散歩に決まってるじゃないっ。お昼なんだから昼食をとるのは当然でしょ」
pages.jaRuby:
「遠坂。なにしてんだよ、こんなところで」
「なっ、なにって散歩に決まってるじゃないっ。お昼なんだから昼食をとるのは当然でしょ」
pages.en:
“Tohsaka. What are you doing out here?”

“Wh-what do you think? I'm taking a walk! And it's lunchtime, so of course I'm going to eat.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka. What are you doing here?”
“I-I’m taking a walk! It’s natural for me to eat lunch during lunchtime, right?”

pages.ja:
……遠坂はあまりにも挙動不審だ。
なにやらモジモジしているというか、俺と視線を合わせようとしない。
pages.jaRuby:
……遠坂はあまりにも挙動不審だ。

pages.en:
…Tohsaka could hardly look more suspicious.

She keeps fidgeting and refuses to meet my eyes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Tohsaka’s acting too suspicious.
She’s restless and doesn’t try to look me in the eyes.

pages.ja:
「そっか、そりゃ当然だ。じゃあいい場所を探してくれ。
俺は生徒会室で飯を食うから」
じゃあな、とお弁当を掲げて背を向ける。
pages.jaRuby:
「そっか、そりゃ当然だ。じゃあいい場所を探してくれ。

pages.en:
“Right. Of course. Well, good luck finding a nice place.

“I'm eating in the student-council room.”

I raise my lunchbox in farewell and turn away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, okay. Then you can continue with your walk.
I’m going to go eat in the student council room.”
I wave her goodbye and turn around.

pages.ja:
「ちょっ、ちょっと待ちなさいっ！ アンタ、わざとやってるでしょ！」
「？」
はてな、と振り返る。
pages.jaRuby:
「ちょっ、ちょっと待ちなさいっ！ アンタ、わざとやってるでしょ！」
「？」
はてな、と振り返る。
pages.en:
“W-wait just a minute! You're doing this on purpose, aren't you!?”

“?”

I turn back, the very picture of bewilderment.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“H-Hold on! You’re doing this on purpose, right!?”
“?”
I turn around.

pages.ja:
「あのな遠坂。何があったか知らないが、そんなんじゃわからない。言いたい事があるんならはっきり言えよ」
「
」
遠坂は言いにくそうにこっちを見ているだけだ。
……むむ。
もしかして、もしかすると……

pages.en:
“Listen, Tohsaka. I don't know what this is about, but I'm never going to understand if you keep acting like that. If you have something to say, just say it.”

“——”

Tohsaka merely looks at me, plainly struggling to get the words out.

…Hm.

Could it be? Is it possible that…?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hey now, Tohsaka. I don’t know what happened, but I don’t understand it like that. If there’s something you want to tell me, go ahead.”
“”
Tohsaka’s looking at me hesitantly.
…Hmm.
Could it be…?

pages.ja:
「昼飯代、忘れたのか？ 弁当はやらないけど、サンドイッチ代ぐらいでいいんなら貸してやるぞ？」
「……っ、んなワケないでしょう、このあんぽんたんっ！！」
pages.jaRuby:
「昼飯代、忘れたのか？ 弁当はやらないけど、サンドイッチ代ぐらいでいいんなら貸してやるぞ？」
「……っ、んなワケないでしょう、このあんぽんたんっ！！」
pages.en:
“Did you forget your lunch money? You can't have my lunch, but if you only need enough for a sandwich, I can lend it to you.”

“…Th-that is *not* what happened, you complete bonehead!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Did you forget your lunch money? I can’t give you my lunch, but I can lend you some money.”
“……! You’re so wrong, you idiot!!”

pages.ja:
があー、と吠える遠坂。
廊下、一斉に静寂。
数秒の後、何事もなかったように喧噪再開。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Tohsaka roars at me.

The entire corridor falls silent.

Several seconds pass.

Then the noise resumes as though nothing ever happened.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka barks out.
The hallway goes quiet.
After a few seconds, everything resumes as if nothing has happened.

pages.ja:
「
」
……なるほど、みんな見なかった事にして現実を守ったんだな。
品行方正、眉目秀麗、優等生の鑑、二年のアイドルと言われている遠坂凛が、廊下で大声をあげ、あまつさえ『あんぽんたん』などと口にする筈がない。
よって、彼らの記憶からここ一分間の記憶は削除されたのだ。

pages.en:
“——”

…I see. Everyone has chosen to preserve reality by pretending they witnessed nothing.

Rin Tohsaka—upright, beautiful, the very model of academic excellence, and idol of the second-year students—could not possibly have shouted in the middle of the hall, much less used a word like *bonehead*.

Therefore, the past minute has been erased from their memories.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I see. Everyone protected their reality by ignoring what happened.
There’s no way that the perfect, beautiful honor student, the school idol, Tohsaka Rin, would scream out the word “idiot” in the hallway.
Therefore, what happened in the past minute was completely erased from their memory.

pages.ja:
「…………………」
……いいなあ。
俺も四日ぐらい前から記憶を修正したい。
pages.jaRuby:

“…………”

…Lucky them.

I'd like to revise my own memories starting about four days ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
…I envy them.
I want to amend my memory from about four days ago.

“—So if it isn't lunch money, what *do* you want, Tohsaka?”

“I… W-well, you're about to eat lunch, aren't you? If you are, would you like to come with me? I know somewhere much nicer than the student-council room.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So? If it’s not lunch money, what is it?”
“Uh… Y-You’re having lunch now, right? Do you want to come with me? I know a better place than the student council room.”
